absences.what: No openly licensed 'keys jingle' recording found on Commons (searches 'keys jingle', 'bunch of keys' returned only podcasts). The key is a paper cutout, so its swing in shot 3 is voiced with paper ticks; no synthetic jingle added.
Commons searches 'paper fold', 'folding paper', 'paper rustle' returned pronunciations/music only; the existing PD 'Book paper pages assorted' is the paper source.
No light-box/fluorescent hum foraged (Commons rate-limited, HTTP 429 repeatedly); hum synthesised at -46 dBFS and declared.
Moving Image Archive cache: station clips (b6e217eb Berlin, cfbbf24e Coney Island) have no or silent audio; Third Avenue El (14c8b94b) has station ambience but unclear rights, rejected.
